summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for c.aydin@aegean.edu. The account's normal pattern is dual daily logins from Manisa, Turkey: campus laptop (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, dev-ca-laptop) midday and mobile phone (Turkcell, dev-ca-phone) evenings. On 2026-10-08, an unknown device (dev-unk-7f3a) from 192.0.2.61 (AS60068 Datacamp Limited, Frankfurt, DE) performed 6 portal authentication failures, then an MFA-approved portal login, followed by mail and SIS access from that same foreign device/IP. Minutes later, a mail flow rule was created forwarding mail to c.aydin.ogr@proton.me via OWA — classic ATO persistence/exfiltration. The legitimate user's normal Manisa logins also continued, consistent with concurrent attacker and legitimate user access. This meets the "contain" definition: confirmed account takeover.
